storage_guards: Destination filesystem selected, including a not-yet-created path.
Configurable nonnegative MiB reserve and exact capacity boundary tests.
Insufficient space stops original download before the network request.
Loss of space mid-transfer removes only that new partial.
Low-space import returns 507 without a partial file.
Native subset/caches/exports refuse writes without touching earlier inputs or results.
Unavailable drive returns a clear preservation error.
Unpersisted initial jobs never enter the live queue.
Unexpected worker failure becomes terminal even if final persistence fails.
A stopped worker pool returns clear 503 without leaving a queued job.
backup_guards: Every included member size and SHA-256 checked before restore.
Unsafe/nonportable paths, special files, duplicate members, manifest disagreements and oversized payloads rejected.
No overwrite of an existing backup or runtime profile.
Failed backup removes its own temporary file and preserves a concurrent output.
Interrupted restore marker blocks app startup.
CLI create, verify and restore exercised.
browser_checks: Original workspace loaded 31 protected inputs and the existing My Tool.
Metadata readiness displayed free GiB and 512 MiB reserve with the non-reservation explanation.
scope: Local runtime reliability and reproducibility. Does not prove independent environmental accuracy, multi-user isolation, encrypted backups, or portable OS/container delivery.
